arc: Little wonders about unseen guests, discovers a helpful whole cell and a smaller package of instructions, follows soap-and-rinse commands, compares antibiotics, and keeps a clue about defenders remembering.
choices: Keep warm-gray Big and cream Little as the pebble guides in every scene.
Ivory sink, amber soap, walnut, linen, book and yogurt unify every scene.
Warm material detail, paper and ink, rare gold; calm spacious compositions.
Microbes live in book illustrations, never floating in the kitchen or visible on skin.
The opening scenic plate also serves as title-card art through the existing titleCard.plate path.

plates.intent: Establish the cozy sink, amber soap, linen towel, magnifier, book and question; the ordinary magnifier does not reveal actual germs.
Discover helpful bacteria through a yogurt cup and a large soft oval cell on a book page; keep the whole-cell idea clear.
Compare a much smaller round virus with the bacterium, and reveal its coiled instructions; a cell supplies the machinery.
Return to the sink for soap, a gentle scrub, rinse and dry; Little follows command sentences.
Revisit the paired book sketches to ask why antibiotics work on bacteria but not viruses; show no medicine or treatment action.
End with Little saving a guest shape in a notebook, echoing defenders learning and remembering, with a kind habit to keep.
